definition: For observed internal state u in R^16 and selected variable u_j, create u^(j) by setting only component j to exactly 0.0 while holding every other observed component fixed; recompute the system objective and all constraint outputs from that intervened state. Do not recompute upstream activations or alter x. Apply separately to each variable and each probe.
implementation_note: B contains synthetic reference-oracle observations for each single-variable intervention. These are prepared data, not an independently executed M1 evaluation.
name: zero-ablation
